cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Remember calling the spare chair unnecessary before giving its place to the cake?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then the guest sat on the piano stool, and you moved the pianist to the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until we open that window to cool the cake. Every sensible decision is now sitting on the next one.

mechanism: Copy a caterer's chair substitution without knowing the first chair was broken, then return seating, cake and a window as interlocking causes of one forced rearrangement.
confusable: Not a detachable catalogue of callbacks: the copied chair decision must make each later object physically constrain the same final choice.
comparison: Room circulation and cake cooling rather than a key/paper access chain.
seedUse: Retains spare chair/cake/piano stool/window chain; grounds the initiating copied removal and makes B supply the blocked-window constraint.
